travelSays.line: 📋 A person, maybe 40s, with tattooed arms wants to know what's by the creek. "Just look. Come back and tell me."

🐪 A river trader walks into Haven a day early — word of the village's standing travels faster than feet. "Heard Haven's name on the river," they say, pack heavy, smile practiced. "Thought I'd see it for myself."

🔥 The fire settles. Rachel has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Bulldozer — I put it down today." "Lowers its head, paws the earth. Dust rises. It is not going around the tree. It has never gone around anything." "It stops. Blood on its snout, sides heaving. It has decided you are not worth dying for — it backs away, quills flat." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Omar mutters "And you're still standing." Dakota asks "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
